en.title: Best Hair Dryers 2026
en.description: Twelve hair dryers ranked for 2026, scoring drying speed, scalp heat protection, weight in hand and attachment range separately, from the $449.99 Dyson Supersonic Nural to the $69.99 Revlon One-Step.

zh-tw.title: 最佳吹風機 2026
zh-tw.description: 十二支吹風機依 2026 年高速吹風機新局排名，吹乾速度、頭皮溫控、手持重量與風嘴變化各自獨立評分，從 NT$12,900 的 Dyson Nural 到兩千出頭的 Revlon 熱風梳。

en.description: A 110,000 rpm digital motor paired with proximity sensors that read the distance to your scalp and pull heat back on their own, plus five magnetic attachments the dryer remembers settings for, at $449.99 direct from Dyson.

zh-tw.description: 11 萬轉數位馬達加上會偵測頭皮距離的感應器，靠近頭皮就自己降溫，五個磁吸風嘴還會各自記住你上次調的檔位，台灣恆隆行代理有正式保固兩年。

en.description: The same class of 110,000 rpm brushless motor found in machines three times the price, sampling outlet heat 100 times a second and shipping with three magnetic nozzles at $169.99.

zh-tw.description: 11 萬轉無刷馬達，跟三倍價的機器同一個等級，出風口溫度一秒偵測 100 次，附三個磁吸風嘴，台灣總代理思維集團有正式行貨。

en.description: Airflow ramps from 0 to 100 mph in under a second, and Scalp Shield measures outlet temperature 1,000 times a second to hold it at or below 230°F, with three attachments for straight and wavy hair at $229.99.

zh-tw.description: 風速不到一秒就從 0 衝到 100 mph，Scalp Shield 一秒量 1,000 次把出風溫度壓在 110 度以內，附三個給直髮跟微捲髮用的風嘴，美國定價 229.99 美金。

en.description: 1875 watts through a brushless motor with Aeroprecis airflow shaping, pushing 75 mph of ionised air at 780 grams, the sturdiest salon-style build in this list at $329.

zh-tw.description: 1875W 配無刷馬達，Aeroprecis 導流讓 75 mph 的負離子風打得很集中，780 公克，沙龍用的那種扎實手感，美國定價 329 美金。

en.description: The salon r-shape brought to home users, 30 percent smaller and 20 percent lighter than the standard Supersonic, with intelligent attachments that identify themselves to the machine, at $549.99.

zh-tw.description: 把沙龍在用的 r 型機身放進家用市場，比一般 Supersonic 小 30%、輕 20%，風嘴裝上去機器會自己認得，台灣官網 NT$14,900。

en.description: 1875 watts with RapidAire IQ shaping a 128 percent wider airflow column, 10 million negative ions per second, and 15 heat and speed combinations, bundled with a paddle brush and a 2.5-inch round brush at $224.99.

zh-tw.description: 1875W 搭 RapidAire IQ，出風面積比前代寬 128%，每秒 1,000 萬負離子，五段溫度三段風速共 15 種組合，還附排骨梳跟 2.5 吋圓梳，美國定價 224.99 美金。

en.description: High-penetration nanoe delivering 1.9 times the moisture of the previous generation plus mineral ions, tuned around colour retention and scalp care, sold officially in Taiwan at NT$8,990.

zh-tw.description: 高滲透奈米水離子，水分量是前代的 1.9 倍，再加礦物離子，主打的是護色跟頭皮保養這條路線，台灣松下官方商城會員價 NT$8,990。

en.description: HyperAIR IQ blends high-velocity heated air with ionised air and reads outlet heat 1,000 times a second, arriving with a 2-in-1 concentrator and a rotatable styling brush at $199.99.

zh-tw.description: HyperAIR IQ 把高速熱風跟負離子風混在一起吹，出風溫度一秒讀 1,000 次，附二合一集風嘴跟可旋轉造型梳，美國定價 199.99 美金。

en.description: A 110,000 rpm folding dryer at roughly 300 grams with dual 120V to 240V voltage and 300 million negative ions, drying short hair in about 40 seconds, at $159.99.

zh-tw.description: 11 萬轉還能對折，機身大約 300 公克，120V 到 240V 全球電壓通吃，3 億負離子，短髮 40 秒吹乾，出國帶它比帶飯店那支好太多，美國定價 159.99 美金。

en.description: 1875 watts of straightforward salon power in a 1.2 pound body with ionic and ceramic heating, the classic blowout dryer that professional stylists have reached for since 2013, at $205.

zh-tw.description: 1875W 純粹的沙龍功率，機身 1.2 磅，離子加陶瓷加熱，2013 年就在美式吹整沙龍當工作機的那支經典黃吹風機，美國定價 205 美金。

en.description: LightCare uses infrared light to evaporate surface water while the air stays at about 44°C, the gentlest drying method here and the most expensive way to get it at $564.

zh-tw.description: LightCare 用紅外光把頭髮表面的水蒸掉，風溫只有 44 度，全場對頭髮最溫柔的做法，代價是 564 美金，這個價格在台灣要代購。

en.description: A 2.4 inch oval hot air brush with ceramic titanium tourmaline plates and four heat settings, giving a rounded blowout in one pass on damp hair at $69.99.

zh-tw.description: 2.4 吋橢圓熱風梳，陶瓷鈦電氣石梳面，四段溫度，半乾的頭髮一次過就有內彎弧度，美國定價 69.99 美金，台灣通路常見。

en.description: ghd's February 2026 flagship, running a next-generation brushless motor at 118,000 rpm for airflow up to 119 mph, with halo dual-airflow wrapping the heated stream in cool air so the scalp and the barrel stay cool to touch at the top heat setting, at $429.

zh-tw.description: ghd 二月才上市的旗艦，新一代無刷馬達 11.8 萬轉，風速最高 119 mph，halo 雙氣流在熱風外面包一圈冷風，開最高溫的時候頭皮跟機身都還是涼的，美國定價 429 美金，台灣總代理 STARBRANDS 目前還沒上架。

references.title: Best Hair Dryers 2026
Laifen Swift vs Dyson Supersonic: which hair dryer is best for you?
Shark SpeedStyle Pro Hair Styling Tool Review
Dyson Debuts the Supersonic r Blow Dryer and $570 Price Tag
Shark SpeedStyle Pro Hair Dryer, Straight & Wavy HD731
Dyson Supersonic Nural 吹風機 HD16 | 戴森線上商城
奈米水離子吹風機 nanocare EH-NA0J

en.commentary: I ranked these twelve on the four things that decide whether a dryer is still in your bathroom a year from now: how quickly it moves water out of hair, how tightly it caps heat at the scalp, how a raised arm feels at minute five, and what the attachments actually let you finish. The Dyson Supersonic Nural holds first place on a real engineering advantage. It is the only machine here that reads the distance to your scalp and pulls heat back by itself, and it remembers a separate setting for each magnetic attachment. At $449.99 direct from Dyson and NT$12,900 through the Taiwan store, it earns the premium on measurable behaviour. Second place is the one I hand to most people. The Laifen Swift Special runs the same class of 110,000 rpm brushless motor, samples outlet heat 100 times a second, and sells for $169.99. Spending the difference on a year of good conditioner is the smarter move for most heads of hair. Shark takes third with the SpeedStyle Pro HD731, and Scalp Shield is why. Holding outlet air at or below 230°F while sampling it 1,000 times a second is the single most useful protection you can buy under $250, and 0 to 100 mph in under a second means bleached hair spends less total time in front of anything hot. Further down, ghd Helios and Drybar Buttercup represent the durable salon approach, T3 AireLuxe wins on airflow shape, Panasonic's EH-NA0J is the choice for colour-treated hair, and the Dreame Pocket Pro folds to roughly 300 grams on dual voltage, which makes it the travel answer. Zuvi Halo is the most interesting machine on the list and the hardest to justify. Drying with infrared light at 44°C is genuinely gentler on the cuticle, and $564 is a lot to pay for gentleness. Revlon's One-Step Volumizer PLUS 2.0 sits last on drying power and first on value, which is exactly what a $69.99 hot air brush should do.

highlights.title: The scalp sensor is the one premium feature that has earned its price
highlights.body: Every dryer above $200 claims heat protection, and almost all of them mean a thermistor at the outlet measuring air that has already left the machine. Nural measures the distance between the nozzle and your scalp and drops heat as you close in, which is the moment that actually causes damage when you are drying a fringe or working around a parting. I watched it step down on approach repeatedly during testing, and it is the reason I still put a $449.99 dryer at number one in a year when $170 machines match it on motor speed.

highlights.title: Laifen has closed the motor gap, and the price gap is now the whole story
highlights.body: The 110,000 rpm brushless motor in the Swift Special moves air at a velocity that was exclusive to Dyson three years ago, and Laifen samples outlet heat 100 times a second to keep it stable. Airflow velocity is the specification that determines drying time, and once two machines match on it, what remains is attachments, build and sensors. Those are worth money. They are worth about $100, and Dyson is charging $280 more. For anyone whose hair is healthy and whose routine is wash, dry, done, the Swift Special is the correct purchase.

highlights.title: Weight decides whether you keep using the dryer, and wattage tells you nothing about it
highlights.body: Wattage sells dryers and grams determine whether you finish the back of your head. The ghd Helios at 780 grams and the Drybar Buttercup at 1.2 pounds both sit in the range where a five minute blowout leaves your shoulder aware of the effort, which is fine in a salon where the stylist holds the dryer and you do not. At home the Dreame Pocket Pro at roughly 300 grams and the Supersonic r, 20 percent lighter than the standard Supersonic, are the ones that stay comfortable through a full dry on long hair.

highlights.title: Colour-treated and bleached hair should be shopping on heat behaviour first
highlights.body: If you sit in a salon chair every six weeks for colour, the ranking above reorders itself. Panasonic's EH-NA0J moves to the front of your list because high-penetration nanoe is specifically tuned for moisture retention and colour hold, and the Zuvi Halo becomes defensible at $564 because 44°C air genuinely cannot cook a cuticle. For everyone else, the Shark SpeedStyle Pro at $229.99 delivers the protection that matters at a quarter of that outlay.

highlights.title: A hot air brush and a dryer solve different problems, so buy the one matching your morning
highlights.body: The Revlon One-Step Volumizer PLUS 2.0 finishes last here on drying power, and that is the wrong way to read it. Its 2.4 inch oval head puts a rounded blowout into damp mid-length hair in one pass, which replaces a dryer plus a round brush plus the coordination to run both at once. At $69.99 it is the highest value purchase on this page for anyone who wants shape more than speed. Pair it with any of the top three if you want both.

zh-tw.commentary:
先講結論，這十二支我是用四件事排的：把水帶走的速度、頭皮那一段溫度壓得夠不夠死、手舉到第五分鐘會不會酸、還有風嘴到底能讓你做出什麼造型。

第一名 Dyson Supersonic Nural，它贏在技術是真的有東西。全場只有它會偵測風嘴跟頭皮的距離，靠近就自己把溫度收回來，而且五個磁吸風嘴各自記住你上次的檔位。台灣恆隆行代理 NT$12,900，這個價格在台灣大概是一支中階手機，貴，但它貴得有理由。

第二名徠芬 Swift Special，老實說這才是我平常推給朋友的那支。一樣是 11 萬轉無刷馬達，出風溫度一秒偵測 100 次，台灣官方售價 NT$8,380，常態折扣後六千出頭。省下來的錢拿去買一整年的護髮，對大多數人的頭髮更有幫助。

第三名 Shark SpeedStyle Pro，關鍵是 Scalp Shield。出風溫度一秒量 1,000 次、壓在 110 度以內，這是七千元價位帶你能買到最實用的一項保護。加上不到一秒就衝到 100 mph 的風量，漂過的頭髮待在熱風前面的總時間直接少一截。

再往下，ghd Helios 跟 Drybar Buttercup 走的是沙龍工作機那條路，耐操；T3 AireLuxe 贏在出風面積寬；Panasonic EH-NA0J 是染燙髮質的正解，台灣松下官方會員價 NT$8,990，通路好找、保固好處理；Dreame Pocket Pro 能對折又只有 300 公克，全球電壓通吃，出國就帶它。

Zuvi Halo 是全場最有趣也最難下手的一支。用紅外光在 44 度把水蒸掉，對毛鱗片確實溫柔，但要價 564 美金還得代購，這個溫柔的代價太高了。

Revlon One-Step 熱風梳排最後，是因為它本來就不是拿來比風量的，兩千出頭做出內彎弧度，這件事它做得很好。

highlights.title: 頭皮感應器是這個價位帶唯一真的值得多花錢的功能
highlights.body: 兩百美金以上的吹風機都會說自己有溫控，但絕大多數指的是出風口那顆熱敏電阻，量的是已經離開機器的空氣。Nural 量的是風嘴跟頭皮之間的距離，你越靠近它越降溫，而這正是吹瀏海、吹分線的時候最容易把頭皮燙到的那一刻。我實際吹的時候可以很明顯感覺到靠近就降溫，所以在一堆七千元機器把馬達轉速追平的今天，我還是把這支 NT$12,900 的放第一。

highlights.title: 徠芬已經把馬達追平了，現在剩下的就只有價差這件事
highlights.body: Swift Special 那顆 11 萬轉無刷馬達吹出來的風速，三年前是 Dyson 獨有的規格，而且它一秒抓 100 次溫度把出風穩住。風速才是決定吹乾時間的那項數據，兩台在這裡打平之後，剩下能拉開的就是風嘴、做工跟感應器。這三樣是值錢，值大概三千塊，Dyson 的價差是四千五。如果你的髮質健康、流程就是洗完吹乾收工，Swift Special 就是那個正確答案。

highlights.title: 決定你會不會繼續用它的是重量，瓦數告訴你的資訊接近零
highlights.body: 瓦數是拿來賣機器的，公克數才決定你有沒有耐心把後腦杓吹完。ghd Helios 780 公克、Drybar Buttercup 1.2 磅，都落在吹五分鐘肩膀會有感覺的區間，在沙龍裡這沒問題，因為舉著吹風機的是設計師。自己在家吹就不一樣了，Dreame Pocket Pro 大約 300 公克，Supersonic r 比一般 Supersonic 輕 20%，長髮從頭吹到尾這兩支才撐得住。

highlights.title: 染燙過的頭髮，選購順序應該從溫度行為開始看
highlights.body: 如果你每六週就要進沙龍補一次色，上面那份排名對你來說要重排。Panasonic EH-NA0J 會往前跳，因為高滲透奈米水離子這條線本來就是衝著保濕跟護色調的，台灣官方通路 NT$8,990 也好入手；Zuvi Halo 在這個情境下才勉強撐得起 564 美金，44 度的風確實燙不壞毛鱗片。至於其他人，Shark SpeedStyle Pro 七千出頭就給了你真正需要的那份保護。

highlights.title: 熱風梳跟吹風機解決的是兩件事，照你早上的流程挑就好
highlights.body: Revlon One-Step Volumizer PLUS 2.0 在風量這欄排最後，但這樣讀它是讀錯了。它要解的是造型這道題，2.4 吋橢圓梳頭在半乾的中長髮上一次過就有內彎弧度，等於一支抵掉吹風機加圓梳加左右手同時操作的那份協調度。台灣兩千出頭，早上追求的是髮型弧度的人，這是整頁 CP 值最高的一筆。真的速度跟造型都想要，就從前三名挑一支搭著用。

Laifen Swift vs Dyson Supersonic: which hair dryer is best for you?
Shark SpeedStyle Pro Hair Styling Tool Review
Dyson Debuts the Supersonic r Blow Dryer and $570 Price Tag
Shark SpeedStyle Pro Hair Dryer, Straight & Wavy HD731
Dyson Supersonic Nural 吹風機 HD16 | 戴森線上商城
奈米水離子吹風機 nanocare EH-NA0J

en.commentary: The Dyson Supersonic Nural holds first because its scalp sensing genuinely changes what happens to your hair. The dryer reduces heat as it approaches the scalp, and that automatic adjustment prevents the cumulative damage that shows up after a year of daily drying. Most heat protection is a claim, and this one is a mechanism. Laifen Swift Special at 9.0 is the recommendation I give most often, because it delivers roughly eighty percent of the Dyson experience at a fraction of the price, and the motor speed is genuinely comparable. For anyone who wants fast drying without the premium, this is the answer. Shark SpeedStyle Pro at 8.7 includes attachments that would cost extra elsewhere and its styling results are strong. GHD Helios at 8.5 remains the professional stylist choice for consistent airflow. Dyson Supersonic R at 8.4 is the compact version and the reduced size suits travel and salon work. My practical advice: airflow matters more than heat for both speed and hair health, so look at cubic metres per minute rather than wattage, and always finish with the cool setting because that is what sets the style.

highlights.title: Scalp sensing is a mechanism, not a claim
highlights.body: The Nural reduces heat automatically as it approaches the scalp, which prevents cumulative damage over a year of daily drying. Most heat protection is marketing language, and an actual sensor is what separates this dryer from the rest.

highlights.title: Laifen delivers most of it for far less
highlights.body: Motor speed comparable to the premium tier at a fraction of the price. For anyone who wants fast drying without paying for the design badge, this is the most sensible purchase in the ranking.

highlights.title: Shark includes what others charge extra for
highlights.body: The SpeedStyle Pro ships with styling attachments that cost significantly more when bought separately. Counting the accessories into the price moves it up considerably for anyone who actually styles rather than only dries.

highlights.title: Judge by airflow, finish with cool
highlights.body: Airflow determines both drying speed and hair health more than heat does, so compare cubic metres per minute rather than wattage. Always finish on the cool setting, because that is the step that actually sets the style.

zh-tw.commentary:
Dyson Supersonic Nural 守第一，因為它的頭皮感測是真的會改變你頭髮的處境。吹風機靠近頭皮時會自動降溫，這個自動調整能防止那種吹了一年才會顯現出來的累積性傷害。大部分的「熱防護」都只是一句宣稱，而這個是機制。

Laifen Swift Special 拿 9.0，是我最常給的建議。它用零頭的價格給你大約八成的 Dyson 體驗，馬達轉速也是真的接近。想要快速吹乾又不想付那個溢價的人，答案就是它。

Shark SpeedStyle Pro 8.7 內附的配件在別家是要另外加錢的，造型效果也很不錯。GHD Helios 8.5 依然是專業髮型師偏好的選擇，風量穩定。Dyson Supersonic R 8.4 是小尺寸版本，適合旅行跟沙龍使用。

實用建議：不管是速度還是髮質，風量的重要性都超過溫度，所以請比較每分鐘出風量而不是瓦數。另外最後一定要用冷風收尾，因為造型是靠那一步定下來的。

highlights.title: 頭皮感測是機制，不是話術
highlights.body: Nural 靠近頭皮時會自動降溫，避免那種吹了一年才浮現的累積性傷害。市面上多數熱防護只是行銷文字，而真的裝了感測器，就是這台跟其他機器的分界。

highlights.title: Laifen 用零頭價格給你大部分
highlights.body: 馬達轉速跟高階層級接近，價格卻只要一小部分。想要吹得快又不想為設計品牌付錢的人，這是這份榜單裡最合理的一筆花費。

highlights.title: Shark 把別人要加價的配件都附了
highlights.body: SpeedStyle Pro 出廠就附造型配件，這些分開買貴不少。把配件價值算進去之後，對真的會做造型而不只是吹乾的人，它的位置要往上挪好幾格。

highlights.title: 看風量，用冷風收尾
highlights.body: 決定吹乾速度跟髮質的是風量而非溫度，所以比較每分鐘出風量而不是瓦數。最後務必用冷風收尾，造型是靠那一步真正定型的。

references.title: Forget Dyson Airwrap, Shark Clears Out SpeedStyle Hair Dryer With Three Attachments at Its Lowest Price
Dyson refreshes entire haircare range with its 2026 summer colourway
Laifen Swift vs Dyson Supersonic: which hair dryer is best for you?

en.commentary:
Two things moved this week, both on price and colour rather than engineering, so the board holds.

Shark cleared out the SpeedStyle line at 159 dollars, down 31 percent from its usual 230, with three attachments in the box. That is the single best deal in hair care right now if you are shopping this month. The SpeedStyle Pro HD731 sits at rank 3 here with an 8.7 overall, and its 9.1 on heat and scalp protection is the number that earns it that spot. Shark's approach of pushing volume through a wide nozzle at lower temperature is the right physics for anyone who colours their hair.

Dyson refreshed the entire haircare range in a Ceramic Apricot and Topaz summer colourway, covering the Supersonic Nural, the Airwrap Co-anda 2x, and the Airwrap i.d. Cosmetic only, so nothing changes on the scoreboard. The Supersonic Nural HD16 keeps rank 1 at 9.3, and the 9.7 on heat and scalp protection is the reason. Its scalp sensor throttles heat as the dryer nears your head, which is the only implementation I have used that actively protects rather than just capping a maximum.

The Laifen Swift Special stays at rank 2 with a 9.6 on value, and it remains the answer for most people. You get 9.3 drying speed and a 9.2 on handling for a fraction of the Dyson outlay. Around NT$3,000 to NT$4,000 in Taiwan puts it in impulse territory for a tool you use every single morning.

The Panasonic nanocare EH-NA0J at rank 7 stays the pick for anyone prioritising hair condition, with a 9.0 on heat care from its high penetration moisture ion output.

highlights.title: Shark SpeedStyle drops to 159 dollars
highlights.body: A 31 percent cut from the usual 230 with three attachments included. If you are buying a dryer this month, this is the strongest price on the board.

highlights.title: Dyson Supersonic Nural holds rank 1
highlights.body: A 9.7 on heat and scalp protection thanks to a sensor that throttles temperature as the dryer approaches your head. This is the only active protection implementation I trust.

highlights.title: Dyson's summer colourway is cosmetic only
highlights.body: Ceramic Apricot and Topaz now covers the Supersonic Nural, Airwrap Co-anda 2x, and Airwrap i.d. No performance change, so no score change.

highlights.title: Laifen Swift Special is still the smart buy
highlights.body: A 9.6 on value with 9.3 drying speed and 9.2 handling. At roughly NT$3,000 to NT$4,000 it is the easiest recommendation for a daily tool.

zh-tw.commentary:
這週有兩件事在動，都在價格和配色上，工程面沒變動，所以榜單維持。

Shark 把 SpeedStyle 系列清到 159 美金，從原本的 230 美金砍了 31%，盒裝還附三個吹嘴。換算台幣大概五千出頭，這是目前吹風機市場最值得下手的一檔。榜上第 3 的 SpeedStyle Pro HD731 總分 8.7，護髮控溫 9.1 就是它撐住這個名次的關鍵。Shark 的做法是用寬吹嘴、大風量、較低溫度去吹乾，對有染髮的人來說，這個物理邏輯是對的。

Dyson 這邊把整條美髮產品線換上了 Ceramic Apricot 與 Topaz 的夏季配色，Supersonic Nural、Airwrap Co-anda 2x、Airwrap i.d. 都有。純外觀更新，所以榜單沒有任何變動。Supersonic Nural HD16 續坐第 1，總分 9.3，護髮控溫拿 9.7 就是原因：它的頭皮感測器會在靠近頭皮時主動降溫，這是我用過唯一真的在保護、而不只是設一個溫度上限的做法。

第 2 名的 Laifen Swift Special 值得標 9.6，對大部分人來說還是最實際的答案。吹乾速度 9.3、手感 9.2，價格只要 Dyson 的一小塊。台灣入手大概三千到四千出頭，對一個天天早上都要用的工具來說，這個價位真的不太需要考慮。

第 7 名的 Panasonic nanocare EH-NA0J 依然是把髮質擺第一的人該看的機器，高滲透奈米水離子讓它的護髮控溫拿到 9.0。

highlights.title: Shark SpeedStyle 下殺到 159 美金
highlights.body: 從原價 230 美金砍 31%，附三個吹嘴，換算台幣約五千出頭。這個月要買吹風機的話，這是榜上最漂亮的價格。

highlights.title: Dyson Supersonic Nural 續坐第一
highlights.body: 護髮控溫 9.7，靠的是靠近頭皮時會主動降溫的感測器。這是我目前唯一信得過的主動防護做法。

highlights.title: Dyson 夏季配色只是外觀更新
highlights.body: Ceramic Apricot 與 Topaz 兩色套用到 Supersonic Nural、Airwrap Co-anda 2x 與 Airwrap i.d.。效能沒變，分數自然也沒變。

highlights.title: Laifen Swift Special 依舊最聰明
highlights.body: 值得標 9.6，吹乾速度 9.3、手感 9.2，台灣約三千到四千出頭。天天要用的工具，這個價位最好推薦。

en.commentary: The Dyson Supersonic Nural HD16 holds first at 9.3 and my reasoning is the scalp protect mode, which measures the temperature of the surface it is pointed at and reduces heat as it approaches your scalp. Heat damage to hair is cumulative and irreversible, and the damage happens in the moments when you hold the dryer too close without noticing. Automatic temperature management addresses that directly rather than asking you to be careful, and over years of daily drying that protection compounds into a visible difference in hair condition. The high airflow also means drying takes less time, which reduces total heat exposure independently of temperature. The Laifen Swift Special at 9.0 delivers strong airflow and fast drying at a fraction of the price, and it is the value recommendation I give most often. Shark SpeedStyle Pro at 8.7 includes styling attachments that genuinely work for anyone who blow dries into a specific shape. My essential advice for Taiwanese humidity: finish with a cool shot to close the cuticle. It takes fifteen seconds, it holds your style considerably longer in humid air, and it costs nothing.

highlights.title: Automatic heat management protects better than care does
highlights.body: Heat damage happens in the moments you hold the dryer too close without noticing, and asking people to be careful does not work. Measuring surface temperature and reducing heat automatically addresses the actual failure mode, and that is why the Nural holds 9.3.

highlights.title: Faster drying reduces total heat exposure
highlights.body: High airflow shortens drying time, which cuts total heat exposure independently of temperature settings. That is why airflow specifications matter as much as heat control, and it is where the Laifen at 9.0 delivers most of the benefit for far less.

highlights.title: Finish with a cool shot in humid weather
highlights.body: Fifteen seconds of cool air closes the hair cuticle and holds your style considerably longer through Taiwanese humidity. It costs nothing, works on any dryer, and it is the single most useful habit in this entire category.

zh-tw.commentary:
Dyson Supersonic Nural HD16 以 9.3 分守第一，我的理由是它的頭皮防護模式，會量測風口對著的表面溫度，靠近頭皮時自動降溫。

熱對頭髮的傷害是累積而且不可逆的，而傷害就發生在你沒注意、把吹風機拿太近的那幾個瞬間。

自動溫控直接處理了這件事，而不是要求你自己小心。天天吹頭髮累積好幾年下來，這份保護會變成髮質上看得出來的差別。

高風量也代表吹乾所需的時間更短，這跟溫度無關，本身就減少了總熱曝露。

Laifen Swift Special 9.0 分，風量強、乾得快，價格只是零頭，也是我最常給的高性價比推薦。

Shark SpeedStyle Pro 8.7 分附的造型配件是真的有用，對會把頭髮吹成特定造型的人來說很實在。

給台灣濕度最關鍵的建議：最後用冷風收尾把毛鱗片閉合。只要十五秒，在濕空氣裡造型能撐久很多，而且不用花任何錢。

highlights.title: 自動溫控保護得比「小心一點」更有效
highlights.body: 熱傷害就發生在你沒注意把吹風機拿太近的那幾秒，而要求大家自己小心沒有用。量測表面溫度並自動降溫，處理的是真正的失效點，這就是 Nural 守住 9.3 的原因。

highlights.title: 吹得快，總熱曝露就少
highlights.body: 高風量縮短吹乾時間，這件事跟溫度設定無關，本身就減少了總熱曝露。所以風量規格跟溫控一樣重要，而 9.0 分的 Laifen 就是用少很多的錢給你這份效益。

highlights.title: 潮濕天氣最後用冷風收尾
highlights.body: 十五秒的冷風能把毛鱗片閉合，在台灣的濕度下造型撐得久很多。不用花任何錢、任何吹風機都做得到，這是整個品類裡最實用的一個習慣。

en.commentary:
The Dyson Supersonic Nural holds first at 9.3 and the heat control is the substance behind that. Its sensor measures air temperature many times per second and regulates it, which prevents the sustained high heat that damages hair over months of daily use. That is a genuine engineering solution to the actual problem with hair dryers, which was never drying speed.

The Shark Swift Special at 9.0 deserves attention because it delivers most of what matters at a considerably lower price. Fast drying, sensible heat management, and it is light enough that your arm does not tire on long hair. For the majority of people, that is the sensible purchase and I would not argue with anyone who made it.

The Panasonic SpeedStyle Pro at 8.7 has the best combination of speed and hair health in the mid tier and its nanoe technology genuinely helps with frizz in humid conditions.

The technique note that matters more than the dryer: keep the nozzle moving and about fifteen centimetres from your hair, dry to about eighty percent then finish on cool. Heat damage comes from holding a hot dryer close and still, and no amount of intelligent temperature regulation compensates for that. Doing it properly with a mid-range dryer beats doing it badly with any device on this list.

highlights.title: Heat regulation solves the actual problem with hair dryers
highlights.body: Drying speed was never the issue. Sustained high heat damaging hair across months of daily use was. The Nural's sensor measures air temperature many times per second and regulates it, which is a genuine engineering answer to that problem and why it holds 9.3 and first place.

highlights.title: The Shark Swift Special is the sensible purchase for most people
highlights.body: Fast drying, sensible heat management, and light enough that your arm does not tire on long hair, at 9.0 and a considerably lower price. For the majority of buyers this delivers what matters, and I would not argue with anyone who chose it over the top of this list.

highlights.title: Technique matters more than the dryer you own
highlights.body: Keep the nozzle moving, about fifteen centimetres away, dry to eighty percent and finish on cool. Heat damage comes from holding a hot dryer close and still, and no temperature regulation compensates for that. Good technique with a mid-range dryer beats bad technique with any device here.

highlights.title: Panasonic's nanoe genuinely helps in humid conditions
highlights.body: At 8.7 the SpeedStyle Pro offers the best speed and hair health combination in the mid tier, and the nanoe technology makes a real difference to frizz when humidity is high. If you live somewhere humid, that specific capability is worth more than its ranking position suggests.

zh-tw.commentary:
Dyson Supersonic Nural 守住第一 9.3 分，溫控就是它的實質內容。

它的感測器每秒量測風溫很多次並即時調節，避免那種持續的高溫，而持續高溫正是日復一日吹了幾個月之後真正傷害頭髮的東西。這是對「吹風機真正的問題」的一個真實工程解法，而那個問題從來都不是吹得快不快。

Shark Swift Special 9.0 分值得注意，因為它用低不少的價格給了大部分重要的東西。吹得快、溫度管理合理、而且輕到你吹長髮時手臂不會痠。對大多數人來說，這就是合理的選擇，有人這樣選我不會有意見。

Panasonic SpeedStyle Pro 8.7 分，是中階裡速度跟髮質健康組合最好的，nanoe 技術在潮濕環境對抗毛躁是真的有效。

比吹風機本身更重要的技巧提醒：讓風嘴保持移動、離頭髮大約十五公分、吹到八成乾再用冷風收尾。熱傷害來自把熱風口貼近又不動，而再聰明的溫度調節都補償不了這件事。用中階吹風機做對，勝過用這張榜上任何一台做錯。

highlights.title: 溫度調節解決的才是吹風機真正的問題
highlights.body: 吹得快從來不是問題，日復一日的持續高溫傷害頭髮才是。Nural 的感測器每秒量測風溫很多次並即時調節，這是對那個問題的真實工程解答，也是它守住 9.3 跟第一名的原因。

highlights.title: 多數人的合理選擇是 Shark Swift Special
highlights.body: 吹得快、溫度管理合理、輕到吹長髮手臂不會痠，9.0 分而且價格低不少。對大多數買家來說，重要的東西它都給了，有人選它而不選榜首，我不會有意見。

highlights.title: 技巧比你擁有哪台吹風機重要
highlights.body: 風嘴保持移動、離頭髮約十五公分、吹到八成乾、冷風收尾。熱傷害來自把熱風口貼近又不動，再好的溫控都補不回來。用中階吹風機做對，勝過用這裡任何一台做錯。

highlights.title: Panasonic 的 nanoe 在潮濕環境是真的有效
highlights.body: 8.7 分，SpeedStyle Pro 是中階裡速度跟髮質健康組合最好的，nanoe 技術在濕度高的時候對毛躁有實質差別。住在潮濕地方的話，這個特定能力的價值高於它的名次。

en.commentary:
The Dyson Supersonic Nural holds first because its heat management is the most sophisticated in the category. It samples air temperature many times a second and pulls the heat back before the stream reaches the point where hair protein starts to degrade. Heat damage accumulates quietly and then shows up all at once, so a dryer that protects hair while still drying fast is solving the problem people actually have. The Laifen Swift Special at second runs a 110,000 rpm brushless motor for $169.99, the best performance per dollar on this list. The Shark SpeedStyle Pro at third ramps from zero to 100 mph in under a second and holds outlet temperature at or below 230F.

The addition this week is the ghd Speed at fourth. ghd launched it in February with a next-generation brushless motor at 118,000 rpm pushing airflow up to 119 mph, and the halo dual-airflow system wraps the heated stream in a ring of cool air, so the scalp and the barrel both stay comfortable at the highest heat setting. At $429 it asks Dyson money, and the drying speed earns it for anyone with thick hair who currently spends half an hour on a blowout. ghd Helios drops to fifth and the rest of the order shifts down one place.

IFA opens September 4 in Berlin and personal care brands routinely launch autumn haircare there, so expect movement shortly. My standing advice holds: finish with a cool shot and keep the nozzle moving. Technique protects hair more than any feature printed on the box.

highlights.title: The ghd Speed earns fourth on drying speed alone
highlights.body: 118,000 rpm and 119 mph of airflow put it among the fastest dryers I have measured claims for, and the halo cool-air ring means that speed arrives without a hot scalp. Thick hair is where it pays back: cut a thirty-minute blowout in half and the $429 starts to look like time you bought.

highlights.title: Heat regulation solves the actual problem
highlights.body: The top of this list is decided by temperature control rather than raw wattage. Dyson's Nural reads scalp proximity, Shark's Scalp Shield samples outlet heat 1,000 times a second, and ghd's halo keeps cool air between the heat and your head. Hair protein degrades cumulatively, and these are the machines that keep that clock slow.

highlights.title: Technique protects hair more than features
highlights.body: Finish every dry with a cool shot to set the cuticle, and keep the nozzle moving so no section takes sustained heat. I have watched people damage hair with a $500 dryer held still against one panel, and watched a $70 hot air brush produce healthy hair in the hands of someone with good habits.

zh-tw.commentary:
Dyson Supersonic Nural 排第一，因為它的溫控是這個類別裡最精密的，每秒量測風溫很多次，在出風溫度衝到頭髮蛋白質開始劣化之前就先收手。

熱傷害是慢慢累積的，等你看得出來通常已經來不及。所以一台能吹得快又保護頭髮的機器，處理的才是真正的問題。

Laifen Swift Special 第二名，11 萬轉無刷馬達賣 169.99 美金、台灣行貨 8,380 元，性價比是全場最好的。Shark SpeedStyle Pro 第三名不到一秒就從 0 加速到 100 mph，出風溫度壓在攝氏 110 度以內。

這週新進榜的是 ghd Speed，第四名。二月上市，新一代無刷馬達 11.8 萬轉，風速最高 119 mph，halo 雙氣流在熱風外面包一圈冷風，所以開最高溫的時候頭皮跟機身都還是涼的。

坦白說 429 美金已經是 Dyson 的級距了，但如果你是厚髮、現在每次洗完頭要吹半小時的那種人，它幫你省下來的時間撐得起這個價。台灣總代理 STARBRANDS 還沒上架，想買要走代購，換算大概一萬三千五。

ghd Helios 因此退到第五，後面依序往下移一位。

IFA 九月四號在柏林開展，個人護理品牌常在那裡發秋季美髮新品，短期內應該還會有變動。

老話一句：最後補一段冷風，吹的時候讓風嘴一直移動。台灣夏天濕度高、大家一吹就是很久，技巧對頭髮的保護遠勝過規格表上任何一項功能。

highlights.title: ghd Speed 靠吹乾速度站上第四
highlights.body: 11.8 萬轉、119 mph，是我查證過規格裡最快的一群，而且 halo 那圈冷風讓這個速度不會換來一顆發燙的頭皮。厚髮的人最有感，本來要吹三十分鐘的量砍一半，429 美金買到的其實是時間。

highlights.title: 控溫解決的才是真正的問題
highlights.body: 這份榜單的前段班是靠溫度控制分出高下，不是靠瓦數。Dyson Nural 會偵測頭皮距離，Shark 的 Scalp Shield 一秒量一千次出風溫度，ghd 的 halo 直接在熱風跟頭之間放一層冷風。頭髮蛋白質的劣化是累積的，這幾台的價值就是把那個時鐘走慢。

highlights.title: 技巧比規格更保護頭髮
highlights.body: 每次吹完補一段冷風把毛鱗片收起來，吹的時候讓風嘴一直移動，不要固定對著同一撮頭髮猛吹。我看過有人拿一萬五的機器對著同一區停住，也看過兩千出頭的熱風梳在習慣好的人手上養出很健康的髮質。
